newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Livshits to re-examine customs duties.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Livshits to re-examine customs duties.

text.p: Russian Finance Minster Alexander Livshits said on Wednesday that Russia should protect its domestic market but not through customs duties.
"We intend to seriously re-examine our approach to defining customs duties," Livshits told a meeting of financiers.
"I do not mean establishing protectionist barriers, but, I would say, some changes that we could call plain and audible defence of the domestic market."
"We consider that the object of regulation of domestic demand should be customs policy," he added, without elaboration.
He said the regulation of domestic demand was a key goal which his ministry would pursue in order to stimulate economic growth in Russia in 1997.
